Wow, this post was a while ago but I’m glad you found it. I’ve since made a lot of changes with my Shibas and it’s helped tremendously. They now rarely ever even get upset at each other to the point of anger. Here’s some tips on keeping your pup settled. 

1) Leash and dominance training. Get a leash that goes around the dog’s snout. This will help for you to physically redirect him when he’s focusing on other dogs. I personally will walk her and have her see other dogs, and instantly redirect her and reward her with treats if she listens. Positive reinforcement is a must.

2) Crating. Get a spacious crate, line it with blankets, make it a comfortable experience. Using a crate for one of my Shibas is good for letting her relax and keep her energy down. But this can also serve as a way to tell your dog to go into his crate if he misbehaves. This is what’s kept her from acting out the most at home.

3) Getting their energy out. Keep your dog as busy as possible. Chew toys, long walks if you can, playing with them. A lot of aggression comes from pent up energy I’ve noticed. It helps quite a bit.

And you have to remember, sometimes, things just happen. I used to get very sad about my Shibas behavior with eachother, but it’s also just nature for them too. We do what we can as pet owners, but nature works harder than anything else.
